demo.title: Counter FSM in SystemVerilog
demo.description: A loadable counter with a synchronous reset, written with separate combinational next-state logic and clocked registers, and its testbench.

demo.title: Shared-memory accelerator in Vitis HLS
demo.description: A Vitis HLS accelerator that takes commands and reads and writes a shared-memory image over an AXI master port, addressed by word offsets, with a C testbench and a notebook.

demo.title: Vector multiply with loop unrolling
demo.description: Element-wise vector multiplication in Vitis HLS over m_axi ports, with a script that sweeps the unroll factor, and a PYNQ overlay.
